use crate::{Diagnostic, DiagnosticKind};
use vexel_base::Span;

pub(crate) struct Reader<'a> { pub bytes: &'a [u8], pub base: usize, pub index: usize }

impl<'a> Reader<'a> {
    pub(crate) fn absolute(&self) -> usize { self.base + self.index }
    pub(crate) fn skip_space(&mut self) {
        while matches!(self.bytes.get(self.index), Some(b' ' | b'\t' | b'\r' | b'\n')) { self.index += 1; }
    }
    pub(crate) fn skip_separators(&mut self) {
        while matches!(self.bytes.get(self.index), Some(b' ' | b'\t' | b'\r' | b'\n' | b',')) { self.index += 1; }
    }
    pub(crate) fn number(&mut self) -> Result<(f64, Span), Diagnostic> {
        self.skip_space();
        let start = self.index;
        let negative = match self.bytes.get(self.index) {
            Some(b'-') => { self.index += 1; true },
            Some(b'+') => { self.index += 1; false },
            _ => false,
        };
        let mut value = 0.0;
        let mut digits = 0usize;
        while let Some(byte @ b'0'..=b'9') = self.bytes.get(self.index).copied() {
            value = value * 10.0 + f64::from(byte - b'0');
            self.index += 1;
            digits += 1;
            if !value.is_finite() || value > 1.0e300 { return Err(self.number_error()); }
        }
        if self.bytes.get(self.index) == Some(&b'.') {
            self.index += 1;
            let mut scale = 0.1;
            while let Some(byte @ b'0'..=b'9') = self.bytes.get(self.index).copied() {
                value += f64::from(byte - b'0') * scale;
                scale *= 0.1;
                self.index += 1;
                digits += 1;
            }
        }
        if digits == 0 { self.index = start; return Err(self.number_error()); }
        if matches!(self.bytes.get(self.index), Some(b'e' | b'E')) {
            let mut lookahead = self.index + 1;
            if matches!(self.bytes.get(lookahead), Some(b'+' | b'-')) { lookahead += 1; }
            if matches!(self.bytes.get(lookahead), Some(b'0'..=b'9')) {
                self.index += 1;
                let exponent_negative = match self.bytes.get(self.index) {
                    Some(b'-') => { self.index += 1; true },
                    Some(b'+') => { self.index += 1; false },
                    _ => false,
                };
                let mut exponent = 0i32;
                while let Some(byte @ b'0'..=b'9') = self.bytes.get(self.index).copied() {
                    if exponent < 10_000 { exponent = exponent.saturating_mul(10).saturating_add(i32::from(byte - b'0')); }
                    self.index += 1;
                }
                if exponent_negative { exponent = -exponent; }
                value *= 10.0_f64.powi(exponent);
            }
        }
        if negative { value = -value; }
        if !value.is_finite() || value.abs() > 1.0e6 { return Err(self.number_error()); }
        Ok((value, Span { start: self.base + start, end: self.absolute() }))
    }
    pub(crate) fn arc_flag(&mut self) -> Result<(f64, Span), Diagnostic> {
        self.skip_space();
        let start = self.index;
        match self.bytes.get(self.index) {
            Some(b'0' | b'1') => {
                let value = f64::from(self.bytes[self.index] - b'0');
                self.index += 1;
                Ok((value, Span { start: self.base + start, end: self.absolute() }))
            }
            _ => Err(self.number_error()),
        }
    }
    fn number_error(&self) -> Diagnostic { Diagnostic { kind: DiagnosticKind::Path, offset: self.absolute() } }
}

pub(crate) fn operand_boundary(reader: &mut Reader<'_>, previous_number: bool, previous_arc_flag: bool, command: u8, argument: usize) -> bool {
    let before = reader.index;
    reader.skip_separators();
    if !previous_number || reader.index != before { return true; }
    if matches!(reader.bytes.get(reader.index), Some(b'+' | b'-' | b'.')) { return true; }
    command == b'A' && (argument == 4 || (argument == 5 && previous_arc_flag))
}

pub(crate) fn validate_commas(bytes: &[u8], span: Span) -> Result<(), Diagnostic> {
    for (index, byte) in bytes.iter().enumerate() {
        if *byte != b',' { continue; }
        let mut left = index;
        let mut right = index + 1;
        while left > 0 && is_space(bytes[left - 1]) { left -= 1; }
        while right < bytes.len() && is_space(bytes[right]) { right += 1; }
        let left_ok = left > 0 && (bytes[left - 1].is_ascii_digit() || bytes[left - 1] == b'.');
        let right_ok = right < bytes.len() && (bytes[right].is_ascii_digit() || matches!(bytes[right], b'.' | b'+' | b'-'));
        if !left_ok || !right_ok || bytes.get(left.wrapping_sub(1)) == Some(&b',') || bytes.get(right) == Some(&b',') {
            return Err(Diagnostic { kind: DiagnosticKind::Path, offset: span.start + index });
        }
    }
    Ok(())
}

fn is_space(byte: u8) -> bool { matches!(byte, b' ' | b'\t' | b'\r' | b'\n') }

pub(crate) fn parse(source: &[u8], span: Span, transform: Affine, options: ParseOptions) -> Result<PathDocument, Diagnostic> {
    let bytes = span.slice(source).ok_or_else(|| failure(DiagnosticKind::InvalidSpan, span.start))?;
    if !affine_valid(transform) { return Err(failure(DiagnosticKind::InvalidTransform, span.start)); }
    validate_commas(bytes, span)?;
    Parser {
        reader: Reader { bytes, base: span.start, index: 0 },
        transform,
        flatness: flatten::tolerance(transform),
        max_commands: options.max_commands.min(MAX_PATH_COMMANDS),
        max_edges: options.max_edges.min(MAX_PATH_EDGES),
        max_numbers: options.max_numbers.min(MAX_PATH_NUMBERS),
        command_count: 0,
        document: PathDocument::new(),
    }.run()
}

struct Parser<'a> {
    reader: Reader<'a>,
    transform: Affine,
    flatness: f64,
    max_commands: usize,
    max_edges: usize,
    max_numbers: usize,
    command_count: usize,
    document: PathDocument,
}

                    cubic_reflect = true;
                    quad_reflect = false;
                    drawn = true;
                }
                b'Q' => {
                    let mut control = Point { x: values[0], y: values[1] };
                    point = Point { x: values[2], y: values[3] };
                    if relative { control = add(control, current); point = add(point, current); }
                    self.check_points(&[control, point], group_start)?;
                    self.add_quad(current, control, point, self.reader.base + group_start)?;
                    quad_control = control;
                    quad_reflect = true;
                    cubic_reflect = false;
                    drawn = true;
                }
                b'T' => {
                    let control = if quad_reflect { reflect(current, quad_control) } else { current };
                    point = Point { x: values[0], y: values[1] };
                    if relative { point = add(point, current); }
                    self.check_points(&[control, point], group_start)?;
                    self.add_quad(current, control, point, self.reader.base + group_start)?;
                    quad_control = control;
                    quad_reflect = true;
                    cubic_reflect = false;
                    drawn = true;
                }
                b'A' => {
                    if (values[3] != 0.0 && values[3] != 1.0) || (values[4] != 0.0 && values[4] != 1.0) || values[0] < 0.0 || values[1] < 0.0 {
                        return Err(failure(DiagnosticKind::Path, self.reader.base + group_start));
                    }
                    point = Point { x: values[5], y: values[6] };
                    if relative { point = add(point, current); }
                    self.check_points(&[point], group_start)?;
                    flatten::arc(&mut self.document.edges, self.transform, current, values[0], values[1], values[2], values[3] == 1.0, values[4] == 1.0, point, self.flatness, self.max_edges, self.reader.base + group_start)?;
                    cubic_reflect = false;
                    quad_reflect = false;
                    drawn = true;
                }
                _ => {
                    point = Point { x: values[0], y: values[1] };
                    if relative { point = add(point, current); }
                    if upper == b'M' {
                        self.check_points(&[point], group_start)?;
                        if open {
                            self.add_edge(current, first, self.reader.base + group_start)?;
                            self.record_subpath(current_subpath_edge, false, self.reader.base + group_start)?;
                        }
                        current = point;
                        first = point;
                        current_subpath_edge = self.document.edges.len();
                        open = true;
                        command = if relative { b'l' } else { b'L' };
                        cubic_reflect = false;
                        quad_reflect = false;
                        continue;
                    }
                }
            }
            if matches!(upper, b'M' | b'L' | b'H' | b'V') { cubic_reflect = false; quad_reflect = false; }
            self.check_points(&[point], group_start)?;
            if !drawn { self.add_edge(current, point, self.reader.base + group_start)?; }
            self.document.segments[segment_index].edge_count = self.document.edges.len() - first_edge;
            current = point;
            open = true;
        }
        if open {
            self.add_edge(current, first, last_group_offset)?;
            self.record_subpath(current_subpath_edge, false, last_group_offset)?;
        }
        Ok(self.document)
    }

    fn check_points(&self, points: &[Point], group_start: usize) -> Result<(), Diagnostic> {
        if points.iter().all(|point| flatten::bounded(*point)) { Ok(()) } else { Err(failure(DiagnosticKind::Number, self.reader.base + group_start)) }
    }
    fn add_edge(&mut self, from: Point, to: Point, offset: usize) -> Result<(), Diagnostic> {
        flatten::edge(&mut self.document.edges, self.transform, from, to, self.max_edges, offset)
    }
    fn add_curve(&mut self, points: [Point; 4], offset: usize) -> Result<(), Diagnostic> {
        flatten::curve(&mut self.document.edges, self.transform, points, self.flatness, self.max_edges, offset)
    }
    fn add_quad(&mut self, from: Point, control: Point, to: Point, offset: usize) -> Result<(), Diagnostic> {
        let c1 = Point { x: from.x + (control.x - from.x) * (2.0 / 3.0), y: from.y + (control.y - from.y) * (2.0 / 3.0) };
        let c2 = Point { x: to.x + (control.x - to.x) * (2.0 / 3.0), y: to.y + (control.y - to.y) * (2.0 / 3.0) };
        self.add_curve([from, c1, c2, to], offset)
    }
    fn record_subpath(&mut self, first_edge: usize, closed: bool, offset: usize) -> Result<(), Diagnostic> {
        let edge_count = self.document.edges.len() - first_edge;
        if edge_count == 0 { return Ok(()); }
        if self.document.subpaths.len() >= MAX_PATH_EDGES { return Err(failure(DiagnosticKind::Limit, offset)); }
        self.document.subpaths.try_reserve(1).map_err(|_| oom(offset))?;
        self.document.subpaths.push(PathSubpath { first_edge, edge_count, closed });
        Ok(())
    }
    fn record_segment(&mut self, command: u8, start: usize, end: usize, command_offset: Option<usize>, numbers: &[PathNumber], first_edge: usize) -> Result<usize, Diagnostic> {
        let offset = self.reader.base + start;
        if self.document.segments.len() >= self.max_commands || numbers.len() > self.max_numbers.saturating_sub(self.document.numbers.len()) {
            return Err(failure(DiagnosticKind::Limit, offset));
        }
        self.document.segments.try_reserve(1).map_err(|_| oom(offset))?;
        self.document.numbers.try_reserve(numbers.len()).map_err(|_| oom(offset))?;
        let first_number = self.document.numbers.len();
        self.document.numbers.extend_from_slice(numbers);
        let index = self.document.segments.len();
        self.document.segments.push(PathSegment {
            command,
            source: Span { start: offset, end: self.reader.base + end },
            command_offset,
            first_number,
            number_count: numbers.len(),
            first_edge,
            edge_count: 0,
        });
        Ok(index)
    }
}

fn add(a: Point, b: Point) -> Point { Point { x: a.x + b.x, y: a.y + b.y } }
fn reflect(origin: Point, control: Point) -> Point { Point { x: 2.0 * origin.x - control.x, y: 2.0 * origin.y - control.y } }

use crate::{failure, oom, Diagnostic, DiagnosticKind, MAX_COORDINATE};
use vexel_geometry::{affine_map_point, Affine, Edge, Point};

pub(crate) fn tolerance(transform: Affine) -> f64 {
    let row_norm = (transform.a.abs() + transform.c.abs()).max(transform.b.abs() + transform.d.abs());
    let column_norm = (transform.a.abs() + transform.b.abs()).max(transform.c.abs() + transform.d.abs());
    let mut scale = (row_norm * column_norm).sqrt();
    if !scale.is_finite() || scale < 1.0 { scale = 1.0; }
    0.25 / scale
}

pub(crate) fn bounded(point: Point) -> bool {
    point.x.is_finite() && point.y.is_finite() && point.x.abs() <= MAX_COORDINATE && point.y.abs() <= MAX_COORDINATE
}

pub(crate) fn edge(edges: &mut Vec<Edge>, transform: Affine, from: Point, to: Point, max_edges: usize, offset: usize) -> Result<(), Diagnostic> {
    if edges.len() >= max_edges { return Err(failure(DiagnosticKind::Limit, offset)); }
    let a = affine_map_point(transform, from).ok_or_else(|| failure(DiagnosticKind::Number, offset))?;
    let b = affine_map_point(transform, to).ok_or_else(|| failure(DiagnosticKind::Number, offset))?;
    edges.try_reserve(1).map_err(|_| oom(offset))?;
    edges.push(Edge { a, b });
    Ok(())
}

pub(crate) fn curve(edges: &mut Vec<Edge>, transform: Affine, points: [Point; 4], flatness: f64, max_edges: usize, offset: usize) -> Result<(), Diagnostic> {
    curve_recursive(edges, transform, points, flatness, max_edges, offset, 0)
}

fn curve_recursive(edges: &mut Vec<Edge>, transform: Affine, p: [Point; 4], flatness: f64, max_edges: usize, offset: usize, depth: u8) -> Result<(), Diagnostic> {
    if point_segment_distance(p[1], p[0], p[3]).max(point_segment_distance(p[2], p[0], p[3])) <= flatness {
        return edge(edges, transform, p[0], p[3], max_edges, offset);
    }
    if depth >= 16 { return Err(failure(DiagnosticKind::Limit, offset)); }
    let a = midpoint(p[0], p[1]);
    let c = midpoint(p[1], p[2]);
    let d = midpoint(p[2], p[3]);
    let e = midpoint(a, c);
    let f = midpoint(c, d);
    let middle = midpoint(e, f);
    curve_recursive(edges, transform, [p[0], a, e, middle], flatness, max_edges, offset, depth + 1)?;
    curve_recursive(edges, transform, [middle, f, d, p[3]], flatness, max_edges, offset, depth + 1)
}

fn midpoint(a: Point, b: Point) -> Point { Point { x: (a.x + b.x) * 0.5, y: (a.y + b.y) * 0.5 } }

fn point_segment_distance(point: Point, from: Point, to: Point) -> f64 {
    let dx = to.x - from.x;
    let dy = to.y - from.y;
    let length_squared = dx * dx + dy * dy;
    if length_squared == 0.0 { return (point.x - from.x).hypot(point.y - from.y); }
    let projection = (((point.x - from.x) * dx + (point.y - from.y) * dy) / length_squared).clamp(0.0, 1.0);
    let nearest = Point { x: from.x + projection * dx, y: from.y + projection * dy };
    (point.x - nearest.x).hypot(point.y - nearest.y)
}

pub(crate) fn arc(edges: &mut Vec<Edge>, transform: Affine, from: Point, rx: f64, ry: f64, rotation: f64, large: bool, sweep: bool, to: Point, tolerance: f64, max_edges: usize, offset: usize) -> Result<(), Diagnostic> {
    let mut rx = rx.abs();
    let mut ry = ry.abs();
    if rx == 0.0 || ry == 0.0 { return edge(edges, transform, from, to, max_edges, offset); }
    if from == to { return Ok(()); }
    let phi = rotation * 0.017453292519943295;
    let (cp, sp) = (phi.cos(), phi.sin());
    let (dx, dy) = ((from.x - to.x) * 0.5, (from.y - to.y) * 0.5);
    let (xp, yp) = (cp * dx + sp * dy, -sp * dx + cp * dy);
    let scale = xp * xp / (rx * rx) + yp * yp / (ry * ry);
    if !scale.is_finite() { return Err(failure(DiagnosticKind::Number, offset)); }
    if scale > 1.0 { let factor = scale.sqrt(); rx *= factor; ry *= factor; }
    let numerator = rx * rx * ry * ry - rx * rx * yp * yp - ry * ry * xp * xp;
    let denominator = rx * rx * yp * yp + ry * ry * xp * xp;
    let ratio = if denominator == 0.0 { 0.0 } else { (numerator / denominator).max(0.0) };
    let sign = if large == sweep { -1.0 } else { 1.0 };
    let coefficient = sign * ratio.sqrt();
    let cxp = coefficient * (rx * yp / ry);
    let cyp = coefficient * (-ry * xp / rx);
    let cx = cp * cxp - sp * cyp + (from.x + to.x) * 0.5;
    let cy = sp * cxp + cp * cyp + (from.y + to.y) * 0.5;
    let (ux, uy) = ((xp - cxp) / rx, (yp - cyp) / ry);
    let (vx, vy) = ((-xp - cxp) / rx, (-yp - cyp) / ry);
    let start = uy.atan2(ux);
    let mut delta = (ux * vy - uy * vx).atan2(ux * vx + uy * vy);
    if !sweep && delta > 0.0 { delta -= std::f64::consts::TAU; }
    if sweep && delta < 0.0 { delta += std::f64::consts::TAU; }
    let radius = rx.max(ry);
    let max_angle = if radius <= tolerance { std::f64::consts::TAU } else { 2.0 * (1.0 - tolerance / radius).max(-1.0).acos() };
    let raw = (delta.abs() / max_angle).ceil();
    if !raw.is_finite() || raw > MAX_COORDINATE * 4.0 || raw > max_edges as f64 { return Err(failure(DiagnosticKind::Limit, offset)); }
    let steps = (raw as usize).max(1);
    if steps > max_edges.saturating_sub(edges.len()) { return Err(failure(DiagnosticKind::Limit, offset)); }
    edges.try_reserve(steps).map_err(|_| oom(offset))?;
    let mut previous = from;
    for index in 1..=steps {
        let angle = start + delta * index as f64 / steps as f64;
        let mut point = Point {
            x: cx + cp * rx * angle.cos() - sp * ry * angle.sin(),
            y: cy + sp * rx * angle.cos() + cp * ry * angle.sin(),
        };
        if index == steps { point = to; }
        if !bounded(point) { return Err(failure(DiagnosticKind::Number, offset)); }
        edge(edges, transform, previous, point, max_edges, offset)?;
        previous = point;
    }
    Ok(())
}
